title: Cozy Orchard Glow

diffuser.notes: Start with 1 cinnamon drop if sensitive; diffuse 30 min on low.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist linens or air.

why_it_works: Sweet orange adds a bright harvest note, cinnamon brings cozy warmth, cedarwood grounds the blend with earthy depth, and ginger offers a gentle spice lift—perfect for crisp autumn evenings.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
